patch.name: voice_memo_pipeline
patch.title: Voice Memo Transcription Pipeline
patch.description: Complete pipeline: Syncthing file watcher → Redis task queue → GPU transcription (faster-whisper) → speaker diarization (pyannote) → PostgreSQL storage → Telegram notification. Includes voice_memos and voice_memo_segments tables, transcription worker for Redis Streams, and file watcher service.
patch.author: Claude

versioning.reason: New major feature: voice memo transcription with diarization pipeline

files_modified: workers/worker.py (adds transcription worker type to registry)
database_changes: Indexes for full-text search on transcripts

verification_steps: Verify transcription appears in voice_memos table
verification_commands: sudo -u postgres psql -d mythos -c "SELECT id, filename, status, duration_seconds, speaker_count FROM voice_memos ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5;"
